map.📖 查看「washer-capacity 使用指南」: 📖 View the usage guide for washer-capacity
map.买洗衣机容量怎么选？按家庭人口数推荐 5–10kg 区间，并结合是否有大件床品/: How to choose washer capacity? Recommend 5-10 kg range by household size, and judge whether larger capacity is needed by bulky bedding/curtains, with single-use water estimate.
map.洗衣机容量按人口与洗涤物推荐：单人 3 至 5 kg、2 至 3 人 6 至 7: Washer capacity recommendation by household size and laundry: single 3-5 kg, 2-3 people 6-7 kg, 4-5 people 8-9 kg, 5+ people 10 kg; when washing bedding or curtains, capacity floats up about 2 kg (a double duvet spread occupies about 4-5 kg capacity); single-use water about capacity(kg) × 10-15 L (pulsator higher, drum lower); selection suggestion by daily need × 1.2 reserve margin.
map.三口之家选 7–8kg，常洗床单被套需 ≥8kg，确保冬被一次洗净不缠团。: Three-person family choose 7-8 kg; often wash sheets/duvet covers need ≥8 kg, ensure winter duvet washed once without tangling.
map.五口 / 大户型选 10kg，窗帘等大件 ≥9kg 一次过水，减少分批。: Five-person / large household choose 10 kg; bulky items like curtains ≥9 kg washed in one go, reducing batches.
map.用水量敏感家庭：滚筒约 9L/kg、波轮约 30L/kg，同等容量波轮费水约 3: Water-sensitive families: drum about 9 L/kg, pulsator about 30 L/kg, same capacity pulsator uses about 3× water.
map.算例（4 口之家，常洗大件）: Example (4-person family, often wash bulky items)
map.4 口 → 基准 8–9kg；常洗冬被 / 窗帘 → 取 9kg。滚筒 9L/k: 4-person → baseline 8-9 kg; often wash winter duvet/curtains → take 9 kg. Drum 9 L/kg×9=81 L/time, pulsator 30×9=270 L/time; if washed 20 times a month, drum saves (270-81)×20=3780 L/month vs pulsator.
map.容量按人口还是按件定？: Capacity by household or by load?
map.先按人口定基准：1–2 人 5–6kg、3 人 7–8kg、4 人 8–9kg、: First baseline by household: 1-2 people 5-6 kg, 3 people 7-8 kg, 4 people 8-9 kg, 5+ people 10 kg; then raise by bulky items (sheets/duvet covers ≥8 kg, curtains ≥9 kg).
map.滚筒省水护衣、贵；波轮便宜费水、伤衣少。小户型看水压与安装位，大件多选大容量滚筒: Drum saves water and protects clothes, but costs more; pulsator is cheaper and uses more water, less cloth damage. Small units check water pressure and install space; bulky-item households choose large-capacity drum; renters/low-frequency choose pulsator more cost-effective.
map.容量参考：1–2 人 5–6kg、3 人 7–8kg、4 人 8–9kg、5 人: Capacity reference: 1-2 people 5-6 kg, 3 people 7-8 kg, 4 people 8-9 kg, 5+ people 10 kg
map.常洗床单被套建议 ≥8kg，窗帘等大件 ≥9kg: Often wash sheets/duvet covers suggest ≥8 kg, curtains and other bulky items ≥9 kg
map.滚筒约 9L/kg、波轮约 30L/kg 用水量差异明显: Drum about 9 L/kg, pulsator about 30 L/kg water usage differs obviously
map.结果仅供参考，结合安装空间与预算选择: Results are for reference only, choose by install space and budget
